nodes.name: Systematic Evaluation of LLM-as-a-Judge in LLM Alignment Tasks: Explainable Metrics and Diverse Prompt Templates
LLM-as-a-Judge
nodes.description: Using commercial LLMs as surrogates for human evaluators to perform pairwise evaluation on LLM alignment tasks.

nodes.name: stratified sampling strategy
nodes.description: Sampling strategy employed to ensure that the subset maintains the same proportion of different conditions as the original dataset.

nodes.name: TL;DR Summarization
nodes.description: A common alignment dataset used in experiments to evaluate LLM judges.

nodes.name: HH-RLHF-Helpfulness
nodes.description: A common alignment dataset used in experiments to evaluate LLM judges regarding helpfulness.

nodes.name: Accboth
nodes.description: Accuracy metric evaluated by considering both response orders.

nodes.name: Accrandom
nodes.description: Accuracy metric evaluated by randomly choosing the response order with a probability of 0.5.

nodes.name: Position Bias (PB)
nodes.description: Metric measuring LLM-judge's systematic preference for a specific response position.

nodes.name: Length Bias (LB)
nodes.description: Metric measuring the relative length bias of LLM-judges compared with human evaluators.

nodes.name: LLM alignment
nodes.description: Techniques and tasks like RLHF and DPO used to align LLMs with human preferences.

nodes.name: flipping noise
nodes.description: Discrepancy between the LLM judge's actual decision and its original decision caused by self-inconsistency.

nodes.name: self-inconsistency
nodes.description: Inconsistent judgments produced by LLM judges even when presented with identical prompts, also referred to as system noise.

nodes.name: Significant impact of prompt templates
nodes.description: Prompt templates have a significant impact on LLM judge performance.

nodes.name: Mediocre human alignment
nodes.description: There is a mediocre alignment level between the tested LLM judges and human evaluators.
